title: Rav Acha Bardela
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav’s student. Sukkah 26a says Rav permitted him to sleep beneath a canopy in the sukkah because of mosquitoes. In Beitzah 14a the text has Rav Acha Bardela speaking to his son; Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav speaking to Rav Acha Bardela. In Gittin 14a Rav tells him, “I have a kav of saffron with you; give it to so-and-so.”

notes.text: למגנא means to sleep; בכילתא means beneath a canopy, and בקי denotes mosquitoes. The Beitzah reading differs over whether Rav speaks to Acha Bardela or Acha Bardela speaks to his son.
